blocks.title: Fossil fuels
blocks.text: Petroleum (kacha tel), koyla aur qudrati gas mil kar fossil fuels kehlate hain.

Kacha tel zameen ke neeche zakhiron se nikala aur bare plants mein fractional distillation se saaf kiya jata hai. Petroleum ki bari products naphtha, gasoline, kerosene aur diesel hain. Methane (CH4) qudrati gas ka bara juz hai, ethane, propane aur butane ke saath mila hua; yeh zyada tar ammonia (khaad, fertilisers ke liye) aur methanol (solvents aur fuel ke liye) banane mein use hota hai. Koyla pehle jitna mufeed nahi raha, lekin jahan zakhire zyada hain wahan ab bhi petrochemical kacha maal hai. Is ka bara istemal benzene, toluene aur xylene hasil karna hai, jo dyes, resins aur dhamaka-khez maddon ki tayyari mein zaruri hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Agarche fossil fuels tawanai ke bohat kaarguzar zaraye hain, in ke jalne se carbon dioxide (CO2) jaisi greenhouse gases banti hain. Is se hawa ki aaloodgi, global warming aur mausami tabdeeli (climate change) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Benzene, toluene aur xylene kis fossil fuel se milte hain, aur kis kaam aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Koyle se; yeh dyes, resins aur dhamaka-khez maddey banane mein use hote hain.

items: Fossil fuels: petroleum, koyla, qudrati gas.
Qudrati gas (CH4): ammonia, methanol; koyla: BTX.
Jalane se CO2: aaloodgi, global warming.
